summary.ru: Британские заморские территории — четырнадцать зависимых территорий, находящихся под британским суверенитетом, но не входящие в состав Соединённого Королевства.
summary.en: The British Overseas Territories are fourteen dependent territories of the United Kingdom that lie outside the British Islands. These territories are remnants of the former British Empire, which remained under British sovereignty following decolonisation, albeit with varying constitutional statuses. Britain is notably the only country to still have territories in every continent on earth, except the continent of Australia.
